BOOKS.title: Some Considerations Touching the Usefulnesse of Experimental Naturall Philosophy
BOOKS.author: Boyle, Robert
BOOKS.note: #5811 item 5. Oxford, Hen. Hall for Ric. Davis 1663 (second part's printed title: 'In the year of our Lord, 1663'; the engraved title OCRs as 1665). Boston College copy. Keller's 'much admir'd digesting furnace' (n.34, Hunter Works vol. 13 p.298) is NOT in this text, nor in the 1671 Part II: Hunter vol. 13 is 'Unpublished Writings 1645-c.1670' (discarded Usefulness sections), so that phrase was never printed in the 17th century. This edition carries the printed Drebbel passages instead: 'a Disciple of Cornelius Drebell ... knew a way of Furnaces that was yet fitter to bring heat to the superlative Degree', 'portable digesting Furnaces, without Fire', and 'a Childe of Cornelius Drebell's' (cancer cure).
